name: DelaySwingTrailUntilRetestAndNewExtreme
longCondition: el_gt(ctx.MarketPosition(), 0) && armedLong && el_ne(lo1, -1.0) && el_le(close[0], lo1 - trailOffsetTicks * tickSize)
shortCondition: el_lt(ctx.MarketPosition(), 0) && armedShort && el_ne(hi1, -1.0) && el_ge(close[0], hi1 + trailOffsetTicks * tickSize)
